item.title: Money operations take idempotency_key and check it first
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry written via `audit.record`.
